dataset: Woolsey Fire 2018 curated event extract from the Citygate After Action Review, Section 3 timeline and Section 2 narrative
interpretation: Rows preserve Citygate's 'Significant Event' numbering and local Pacific Standard Time. The AAR states that untimed events are placed chronologically between time-stamped events; untimed rows are therefore bounded by the nearest preceding and following time-stamped rows in source order (see normalizer). '(approximate)' stamps keep the stamped minute with time_precision 'approximate' and no invented window. Message times (tweets, Alert LA, city notices, emails) are when the message was sent or logged, not necessarily when an order was decided. Descriptions are paraphrases; quotes are verbatim and 25 words or fewer. Victim details, private individuals and addresses are omitted; entrapments and fatalities are aggregate counts.
